name: Academic Affairs Cell
desc: Focuses on academic development and student learning through seminars, workshops and educational support activities.

name: Alumni Relations Cell
desc: Maintains connections with former students, facilitating professional networking, mentorship and engagement programs.

name: Community Outreach Cell
desc: Encourages student participation in social service and community development initiatives through awareness and support programs.

name: Cultural Cell
desc: Celebrates India's cultural heritage and diversity by organizing festivals, stage performances and arts competitions.

name: Debate & Public Speaking Cell
desc: Develops communication, critical thinking and parliamentary discourse through debates, Model UNs (MUNs) and public speaking competitions.

name: Diversity & Inclusion Cell
desc: Promotes equality, inclusivity and mutual respect on campus, fostering an open, welcoming environment for all students.

name: Divyang Students Cell
desc: Supports students with disabilities, advocating for campus accessibility, equal opportunity and institutional inclusion.

name: EduAI Cell
desc: Explores Artificial Intelligence in education by organizing technical workshops, AI training sessions and awareness campaigns.

name: Environment Cell
desc: Drives campus environmental awareness and sustainability projects such as plantation drives and cleanliness campaigns.
highlight: Recent Initiative: Conducted a "Serene Water Bowl Drive" spanning SRCC, Arts Faculty and Daulat Ram College.

name: Fashion Club
desc: Promotes fashion, styling and creative design through campus fashion shows, showcases and design events.

name: Film & Photography Cell
desc: Provides visual storytelling platforms in filmmaking and photography via film screenings, photo contests and technical workshops.

name: Fine Arts Cell
desc: Encourages painting, sketching, crafts and visual art mediums through art exhibitions, creative workshops and competitions.

name: Hostel Cell
desc: Addresses hostel-related student grievances and logistics while promoting inter-hostel cultural and recreational activities.

name: Ideological Event Cell
desc: Offers a platform for intellectual dialogue on social, political and national issues through seminars and panel discussions.

name: Innovation & Incubation Cell
desc: Fosters student innovation, problem-solving and technology-driven projects to nurture early-stage startup ideas.

name: International Students Cell
desc: Assists international students with academic and campus integration while organizing cross-cultural exchange programs.

name: Language Exchange Club
desc: Encourages multilingual learning and linguistic exchange to build broader cross-cultural understanding.

name: Legal Aid Cell
desc: Spreads awareness regarding legal rights and responsibilities through literacy and guidance sessions.
highlight: Key Activity: Filed RTIs regarding election governance matters (e.g. Section 163 BNSS context).

name: Literary Cell
desc: Promotes creative writing, poetry and literary discourse through book reviews, competitions and author interactions.

name: Media & Publications Cell
desc: Manages DUSU content creation, reporting and media publicity via articles, campus newsletters and press coverage.

name: Mental Health & Wellness Cell
desc: Promotes psychological well-being among students through counselling awareness sessions, stress management and mental health drives.

name: PG Cell
desc: Dedicated to postgraduate students' academic and welfare needs, fostering inter-departmental PG student networking.

name: Placement Cell
desc: Facilitates employment opportunities and career progression through placement drives, corporate talks and skill workshops.

name: Research & Development Cell
desc: Promotes academic rigour and policy research, supporting student-led research initiatives and analytical projects.

name: Social Service Cell
desc: Engages students in community volunteerism, social welfare drives and humanitarian relief efforts across Delhi-NCR.

name: Sports Cell
desc: Promotes athletics, sportsmanship and physical fitness by organizing inter-college tournaments and sporting events.

name: Startup & Entrepreneurship Cell
desc: Supports student entrepreneurs through startup pitch sessions, mentorship networks and business innovation workshops.

name: Student Welfare Cell
desc: Acts as the primary grievance bridge between students and university authorities for general student welfare issues.

name: Theatre & Drama Cell
desc: Encourages theatrical performing arts through stage plays, street theatre (Nukkad Natak) and dramatic workshops.

name: Women Empowerment Cell
desc: Advocates female student rights, safety and leadership development via empowerment workshops, self-defence sessions and mentorship.
